أرتكس (form VIII)
# أَرْتَكِسُ (ʔartakisu) /ʔar.ta.ki.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# أُرْتَكَسُ (ʔurtakasu) /ʔur.ta.ka.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# أَرْتَكِسَ (ʔartakisa) /ʔar.ta.ki.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# أُرْتَكَسَ (ʔurtakasa) /ʔur.ta.ka
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
